intent.logline_zh: 晴天街头，年轻女孩笑着说出今天天气真好、叫人跟上。

characters.desc_zh: 20岁左右年轻女孩，肩长发，浅色夹克，在画内行走

must_keep_quotes: 今天天气真好，快跟上我呀

beats.what_zh: 女孩笑着朝镜头方向走，相机缓慢推近

dialogue.speaker: S1
dialogue.line: 今天天气真好，快跟上我呀。

risks: 原文无说话人归属，已默认唯一的女孩为 S1 并钉身份；若另有其人需改 ID

pe.integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action sunny street in daylight. A young woman in her 20s (S1), on-screen, shoulder-length hair and a light jacket, walks toward the camera with a bright smile. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she says cheerfully in Mandarin <d>[Chinese] 今天天气真好，快跟上我呀。</d> One continuous shot with no cuts.
pe.overall_soundscape: Light wind, distant traffic and her footsteps on the pavement.
